evidence.query: SELECT Id, OwnerId, LeadSource, CreatedDate, IsConverted, ConvertedDate, ConvertedOpportunityId, ConvertedContactId FROM Lead WHERE CreatedDate >= 2024-10-31T00:00:00Z AND CreatedDate <= 2026-10-31T12:00:00Z

assumptions: Days, months and quarters are in the org's time zone, Europe/London

segments.notMeasurableReason: Sample below the calibrated minimum (9 of 20)
